children: Meeza, the Qatar-listed data centre and managed IT services provider, has inked a 1 billion riyals ($275 million) agreement with a global hyperscaler to provide 8 megawatts of operational capacity under a long-term leasing agreement.
Details of the hyperscaler have not been disclosed.

Meeza said the deal reflects a “growing demand” for data centre capacity driven by the expansion of “cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and data-intensive technologies”, adding that the new data centre campus will support the hyperscaler’s cloud and AI workloads.
Meeza, which operates five certified data centres, said with this deal the company is on track to “quadruple” its current data centre capacity.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Daniel Luiz)

title: Qatar data centre provider Meeza inks $275mln deal with hyperscaler
